title: A documented integer parameter supports a native integer return without coercion

ground_truth.statement: A documented integer parameter supports a native integer return without coercion. This isolates the type contract from the upstream prefix parsing matrix.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Only the documented parameter contract is retained; proprietary prefix precedence, invalid type spellings and unrelated upstream classes are intentionally not reproduced. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
